<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>POS Converter v5 – Field Tech by cyp</title>
<style>
:root{
--bg:#0b1220;--panel:#131c2e;--panel2:#1a2540;--line:#2a3856;
--accent:#38bdf8;--accent2:#0ea5e9;--text:#f1f5f9;--muted:#94a3b8;
--ok:#22c55e;--warn:#eab308;--err:#ef4444;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:14px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono',Consolas,ui-monospace,monospace;padding:1.25rem}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:.9rem;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
h1{margin:0;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--accent)}
.badge{background:#0369a1;color:#e0f2fe;font-size:.65rem;padding:.15rem .45rem;border-radius:4px;margin-left:.4rem}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.1rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.card>h3{margin:0 0 .8rem;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem}
.step{background:var(--accent);color:#06121f;border-radius:50%;width:22px;height:22px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700}
details.card>summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);font-size:.95rem}
details.card>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details.card[open]>summary{margin-bottom:.8rem}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:.7rem}
.fg label{display:block;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.25rem}
input,select{background:#0b1220;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);border-radius:5px;padding:.4rem .55rem;font:inherit;font-size:.82rem;width:100%}
input:focus,select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.row{display:flex;gap:.4rem;align-items:center}
.row input{flex:1;min-width:0}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;border-radius:5px;padding:.45rem .8rem;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;transition:.15s}
.b-primary{background:var(--accent);color:#06121f}.b-primary:hover{background:var(--accent2);color:#fff}
.b-sec{background:#334155;color:#fff}.b-sec:hover{background:#475569}
.b-danger{background:#7f1d1d;color:#fecaca}.b-danger:hover{background:var(--err);color:#fff}
button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.hint{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--warn);margin-top:.4rem}
.tag{font-size:.68rem;padding:.1rem .4rem;border-radius:4px;margin-left:.4rem}
.tag.ok{background:#14532d;color:#bbf7d0}.tag.bad{background:#7f1d1d;color:#fecaca}
.drop{border:2px dashed var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.8rem;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;background:#0b122055;transition:.15s}
.drop:hover,.drop.over{border-color:var(--accent);background:#0ea5e911}
.drop small{color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:.3rem}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.9rem}
.chip{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:.35rem .7rem;font-size:.75rem}
.chip b{color:var(--accent);font-size:.95rem;margin-right:.3rem}
.chip.w b{color:var(--warn)}.chip.e b{color:var(--err)}
.toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.7rem}
.toolbar input[type=search]{max-width:260px}
.toolbar select{width:auto}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:.4rem;margin-bottom:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tab{background:var(--panel2);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tab.on{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--accent);background:#0ea5e922}
.pane{display:none}.pane.on{display:block}
.scroll{max-height:520px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.78rem}
th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#0b1220;color:var(--accent);text-align:left;padding:.45rem;z-index:1;white-space:nowrap}
td{padding:.2rem .3rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
td input{padding:.3rem .4rem;font-size:.78rem;border-color:transparent;background:transparent}
td input:hover{border-color:var(--line)}
td input:focus{background:#0b1220}
td input.bad{border-color:var(--err);background:#ef444422}
td input.warn{border-color:var(--warn);background:#eab30818}
td.n{width:78px}td.t{width:64px}td.x{width:36px;text-align:center}
.exports{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:.7rem}
.exp{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:.8rem}
.exp h4{margin:0 0 .3rem;font-size:.82rem}
.exp p{margin:0 0 .6rem;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted)}
.exp button{width:100%}
.log{background:#000;color:#4ade80;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:.6rem;font-size:.72rem;max-height:130px;overflow:auto;margin-top:.8rem}
.log .w{color:var(--warn)}.log .e{color:var(--err)}
#toast{position:fixed;right:1rem;bottom:1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.4rem;z-index:50}
.t-item{background:var(--panel2);border-left:4px solid var(--accent);padding:.55rem .8rem;border-radius:6px;font-size:.78rem;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0008;animation:in .2s}
.t-item.ok{border-color:var(--ok)}.t-item.err{border-color:var(--err)}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:1.5rem;font-size:.8rem}
@media(max-width:640px){body{padding:.6rem}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
<header>
<h1>⚡ POS Converter <span class="badge">FIELD TECH v5</span> <span class="sub">by cyp</span></h1>
<div class="sub">100 % local • Nova / CSV / JSON Popina → édition → export</div>
</header>
<!-- 1. Établissement -->
<details class="card" id="etab" open>
<summary>⚙️ 1 · Informations de l'établissement <span class="sub">(sauvegardées automatiquement dans ce navigateur)</span></summary>
<div class="grid">
<div class="fg"><label>Nom du commerce</label><input id="f_name" placeholder="Mon Commerce"></div>
<div class="fg"><label>SIRET / SIREN <span id="siretTag"></span></label><input id="f_siret" placeholder="123 456 789 00012" inputmode="numeric"></div>
<div class="fg"><label>N° TVA intracommunautaire</label>
<div class="row"><input id="f_tva" placeholder="Saisir ou générer"><button type="button" class="b-sec" id="btnTva">Générer</button></div></div>
<div class="fg"><label>Code NAF / APE</label><input id="f_naf" placeholder="1071C"></div>
<div class="fg"><label>Adresse</label><input id="f_address" placeholder="12 Rue de la République"></div>
<div class="fg"><label>Code postal</label><input id="f_zip" placeholder="75001" inputmode="numeric"></div>
<div class="fg"><label>Ville</label><input id="f_city" placeholder="Paris"></div>
<div class="fg"><label>Téléphone</label><input id="f_phone" placeholder="01 23 45 67 89"></div>
<div class="fg"><label>Code vendeur (Gérant)</label><input id="f_gerant" value="0000"></div>
</div>
<div class="toolbar" style="margin-top:.8rem"><button class="b-sec" id="btnResetEtab">Effacer ces infos</button></div>
</details>
<!-- 2. Import -->
<div class="card">
<h3><span class="step">2</span> Importer un fichier</h3>
<div class="drop" id="drop">
<div>Glissez ici votre fichier ou cliquez pour parcourir</div>
<small>Détection automatique : <b>prog_nova.csv</b> (Nova) · <b>CSV Popina</b> · <b>JSON Popina</b></small>
<input type="file" id="file" accept=".csv,.json,.txt" style="display:none">
</div>
<div class="toolbar" style="margin-top:.7rem">
<button class="b-sec" id="btnSample">Charger un exemple CSV</button>
<button class="b-danger" id="btnClear" disabled>Tout vider</button>
<span class="sub" id="srcInfo"></span>
</div>
<div class="log" id="log" style="display:none"></div>
</div>
<!-- 3. Édition -->
<div class="card" id="editorCard" style="display:none">
<h3><span class="step">3</span> Vérifier &amp; éditer</h3>
<div class="chips" id="chips"></div>
<div class="tabs">
<button class="tab on" data-pane="pItems">Articles</button>
<button class="tab" data-pane="pLists">Listes de condiments</button>
<button class="tab" data-pane="pPlaces">Pôles de préparation</button>
</div>
<div class="pane on" id="pItems">
<div class="toolbar">
<input type="search" id="q" placeholder="🔎 Filtrer (nom, groupe, famille)…">
<button class="b-sec" id="btnAdd">+ Article</button>
<span class="sub">TVA en masse :</span>
<select id="bulkTva"><option value="">—</option><option>5.5</option><option>10</option><option>20</option></select>
<button class="b-sec" id="btnBulkTva">Appliquer aux lignes affichées</button>
<button class="b-sec" id="btnDedupe">Fusionner doublons</button>
<span class="sub">Pôle :</span>
<select id="bulkPlace"></select>
<button class="b-sec" id="btnPlaceAdd">Affecter</button>
<button class="b-sec" id="btnPlaceRemove">Retirer</button>
<button class="b-sec" id="btnPlaceSet">Remplacer</button>
<span class="sub">(sur les lignes affichées)</span>
</div>
<div class="scroll"><table>
<thead><tr><th>Groupe</th><th>Famille</th><th>Article</th><th>Prix place €</th><th>TVA %</th><th>Prix empt. €</th><th>TVA %</th><th>Pôles de préparation</th><th>Listes</th><th></th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="tbody"></tbody>
</table></div>
<div class="hint">💡 Cellules orange = à vérifier (prix 0, TVA hors 5,5/10/20, doublon). Rouge = invalide.</div>
</div>
<div class="pane" id="pLists">
<div class="scroll"><table>
<thead><tr><th>Nom de la liste</th><th>Options</th><th>Obligatoire</th><th>Choix multiple</th><th>Articles liés</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="lbody"></tbody>
</table></div>
<div class="hint">Les listes proviennent de Nova (LC/LK) ou d'un JSON Popina existant.</div>
</div>
<div class="pane" id="pPlaces">
<div class="toolbar">
<input id="newPlace" placeholder="Nouveau pôle (ex : Chaud, Froid…)" style="max-width:280px">
<button class="b-sec" id="btnAddPlace">+ Ajouter le pôle</button>
<button class="b-sec" id="btnQuickPlaces">Ajouter Chaud + Froid</button>
</div>
<div class="scroll"><table>
<thead><tr><th>Nom du pôle</th><th>Articles affectés</th><th></th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="pbody"></tbody>
</table></div>
<div class="hint">💡 Astuce : filtrez par famille dans l'onglet Articles (ex. « Softs »), choisissez un pôle puis « Affecter ».<br>
⚠ Les affectations sont écrites dans <code>places[].items</code> (liste d'identifiants d'articles, au format texte). Les imprimantes se règlent ensuite dans le Back-Office.</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 4. Export -->
<div class="card" id="exportCard" style="display:none">
<h3><span class="step">4</span> Exporter</h3>
<div class="exports">
<div class="exp"><h4>📦 JSON Back-Office Popina</h4><p>Carte complète + listes + paramètres de l'établissement.</p><button class="b-primary" data-exp="json">Télécharger .json</button></div>
<div class="exp"><h4>📄 CSV Popina (tableur)</h4><p>Pour retravailler sous Excel (UTF-8 BOM, séparateur ;).</p><button class="b-primary" data-exp="csv">Télécharger .csv</button></div>
<div class="exp"><h4>🧾 CSV SmartTDE</h4><p>Prix en centimes, sans TVA.</p><button class="b-primary" data-exp="tde">Télécharger .csv</button></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="toast"></div>
<script>
/* ============ Utils ============ */
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const uuid = () => (crypto && crypto.randomUUID) ? crypto.randomUUID() :
'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, c => { const r = Math.random()*16|0; return (c==='x'?r:(r&3|8)).toString(16); });
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
const clean = s => { if(s==null) return ''; let c = String(s).replace(/[\x00-\x1F\x7F-\x9F]/g,'').replace(/\u00A0/g,' ').trim(); return c.length>254 ? c.slice(0,254) : c; };
const num = v => { const n = parseFloat(String(v ?? '').replace(',', '.').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,'')); return isNaN(n) ? NaN : n; };
const slug = s => (s||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'_').replace(/^_|_$/g,'');
function toast(msg, type=''){
const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 't-item '+type; d.textContent = msg;
$('toast').appendChild(d); setTimeout(()=>d.remove(), 4200);
}
function log(msg, cls=''){
const l = $('log'); l.style.display='block';
l.innerHTML += `<div class="${cls}">[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR')}] ${esc(msg)}</div>`;
l.scrollTop = l.scrollHeight;
}
function download(content, filename, mime, bom=false){
const blob = new Blob(bom ? ['\ufeff', content] : [content], {type: mime});
const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = filename;
document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
}
function decode(buf){
try { return new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(buf); }
catch(e){ return new TextDecoder('windows-1252').decode(buf); }
}
/* ============ Établissement ============ */
const FIELDS = ['name','siret','tva','naf','address','zip','city','phone','gerant'];
const LS_KEY = 'pos_converter_v5_etab';
function saveEtab(){ try{ const o={}; FIELDS.forEach(f=>o[f]=$('f_'+f).value); localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(o)); }catch(e){} }
function loadEtab(){ try{ const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY)||'null'); if(o) FIELDS.forEach(f=>{ if(o[f]!=null) $('f_'+f).value=o[f]; }); }catch(e){} checkSiret(); }
function etab(){ const o={}; FIELDS.forEach(f=>o[f]=clean($('f_'+f).value)); if(!o.gerant) o.gerant='0000'; return o; }
function luhn(d){ let s=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){ let n=+d[d.length-1-i]; if(i%2){ n*=2; if(n>9) n-=9; } s+=n; } return s%10===0; }
function checkSiret(){
const d = $('f_siret').value.replace(/\D/g,''), t =$('siretTag');
if(!d){ t.textContent=''; t.className=''; return; }
const okLen = d.length===9 || d.length===14;
const ok = okLen && luhn(d);
t.className = 'tag ' + (ok?'ok':'bad');
t.textContent = ok ? 'valide' : (okLen ? 'clé Luhn invalide' : d.length+' chiffres');
}

/* ============ État ============ */
const defaultPlaces = () => [
{id:'5F6F94EC-19FE-44DA-B5AF-8989AC340E44', name:'Cuisine', extra:{}},
{id:'CBC89272-5DC4-4E60-B2E4-A0650E41822F', name:'Bar', extra:{}}
];
const state = { rows: [], lists: [], places: defaultPlaces(), source: '', fileName: '' };
/* ============ Parsers ============ */
function parseNova(text){
const sections = {}, headers = {}; let cur = null;
for(let line of text.split(/\r?\n/)){
line = line.trim(); if(!line || line.startsWith('!')) continue;
const p = line.split(';');
if(p.length>1 && !/^\d+$/.test(p[0])){ cur = p[0]; headers[cur] = p; sections[cur] = []; continue; }
if(cur && /^\d+$/.test(p[0])) sections[cur].push(p);
}
const col = (sec, name, fb) => { const i = (headers[sec]||[]).indexOf(name); return i>-1 ? i : fb; };
const taxVal = code => {
if(code==null || String(code).trim()==='') return 20;
const n = num(code); if(isNaN(n)) return 20;
if(n===20||n===10||n===5.5) return n;
return ({0:10,1:20,2:5.5,3:0})[Math.round(n)] ?? 20;
};
const groups = {}; (sections.G||[]).forEach(p=>groups[p[0]] = clean(p[1]));
const depts = {}; { const d=col('D','DESC',9); (sections.D||[]).forEach(p=>depts[p[0]] = clean(p[d])); }
const mk = (sec, withPrice) => { const out={}; const d=col(sec,'DESC',1), pr=col(sec,'PRICE',2);
(sections[sec]||[]).forEach(p=>out[p[0]] = {name:clean(p[d]), price: withPrice ? (num(p[pr])||0) : 0}); return out; };
const cItems = mk('C',true), kItems = mk('K',false);
const lists = {};
[['LC',cItems],['LK',kItems]].forEach(([sec,src])=>{
const d=col(sec,'DESC',1), it=col(sec,'ITEM',2);
(sections[sec]||[]).forEach(p=>{
if(!lists[p[0]]) lists[p[0]] = {id:p[0], name:clean(p[d]) || ('Liste '+p[0]), mandatory:true, multiple:false, options:[]};
const o = src[p[it]]; if(o && o.name) lists[p[0]].options.push({...o});
});
});
const A = sections.A || [];
const iD=col('A','DESC',19), iG=col('A','GROUP',20), iDept=col('A','DEPT',71), iP1=col('A','PRICE1',27), iP2=col('A','PRICE2',28), iT1=col('A','TAX1',2), iT2=col('A','TAX2',3);
const combo = (headers.A||[]).map((h,i)=>h.startsWith('COMBOLINK')?i:-1).filter(i=>i>-1);
const rows = [];
A.forEach(p=>{
const name = clean(p[iD]);
if(p[9]==='1' || !name || name==='0' || name.length<2) return;
const g = groups[p[iG]] || 'DIVERS';
const cat = depts[p[iDept]] || g;
const p1 = num(p[iP1])||0, p2 = num(p[iP2])||0;
const links = [...new Set(combo.map(i=>p[i]).filter(v=>v && v!=='0'))].filter(id=>lists[id] && lists[id].options.length);
rows.push({ groupe:g, category:cat, name, price:p1, tva:taxVal(p[iT1]),
price2: p2>0 ? p2 : null, tva2: p2>0 ? taxVal(p[iT2]!=='' && p[iT2]!=null ? p[iT2] : p[iT1]) : null, listIds:links, placeIds:[] });
});
return { rows, lists: Object.values(lists).filter(l=>l.options.length) };
}
function splitCSV(line, d){
const out=[]; let cur='', q=false;
for(let i=0;i<line.length;i++){ const c=line[i];
if(c==='"'){ if(q && line[i+1]==='"'){ cur+='"'; i++; } else q=!q; }
else if(c===d && !q){ out.push(cur.trim()); cur=''; } else cur+=c; }
out.push(cur.trim()); return out;
}
function parsePopinaCSV(text){
const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l=>l.trim());
if(lines.length<2) throw new Error('CSV vide');
const d = (lines[0].match(/;/g)||[]).length >= (lines[0].match(/,/g)||[]).length ? ';' : ',';
const H = splitCSV(lines[0], d).map(h=>h.toLowerCase());
const f = fn => H.findIndex(fn);
let iG = f(h=>h.includes('groupe')||h.includes('macro'));
let iC = H.findIndex((h,i)=>i!==iG && (h.includes('famille')||h.includes('categorie')||h.includes('catégorie')||h.includes('sous-cat')));
let iN = f(h=>h.includes('description')||h.includes('nom')||h.includes('article'));
let iP = f(h=>h.includes('prix sur place')||h.includes('prix 1')||h==='prix'||h.includes('prix_ttc'));
let iT = f(h=>h.includes('tva sur place')||h==='tva');
let iP2 = f(h=>h.includes('prix emporter')||h.includes('prix 2'));
let iT2 = f(h=>h.includes('tva emporter')||h.includes('tva 2'));
if(iG===-1 && H.length>=2 && /cat|famille/.test(H[0]) && /cat|famille/.test(H[1])){ iG=0; iC=1; }
if(iC===-1) iC = 0;
if(iN===-1) iN=2; if(iP===-1) iP=3; if(iT===-1) iT=4;
if(iP2===-1 && H.length>5) iP2=5; if(iT2===-1 && H.length>6) iT2=6;
const rows=[];
for(let i=1;i<lines.length;i++){
const c = splitCSV(lines[i], d); const name = clean(c[iN]); if(!name) continue;
const p2 = iP2>=0 && c[iP2] ? num(c[iP2]) : NaN;
const t = num(c[iT]); const t2 = iT2>=0 && c[iT2] ? num(c[iT2]) : NaN;
rows.push({ groupe: iG>=0 ? clean(c[iG])||'Groupe 1' : 'Groupe 1', category: clean(c[iC])||'Général', name,
price: num(c[iP])||0, tva: isNaN(t)?20:t,
price2: isNaN(p2)?null:p2, tva2: isNaN(p2)?null:(isNaN(t2)?(isNaN(t)?20:t):t2), listIds:[], placeIds:[] });
}
return { rows, lists: [] };
}
/* ============ CORRECTION MAJEURE PARSER JSON ============ */
function parsePopinaJSON(obj){
if(!Array.isArray(obj.items)) throw new Error('JSON sans "items"');
const tax = {}; (obj.taxes||[]).forEach(t=>tax[t.client_id] = (t.percentage||2000)/100);
const macro = {}; (obj.macro_categories||[]).forEach(m=>macro[m.client_id]=m.name);
const catOf = {}; ((obj.cards&&obj.cards[0]&&obj.cards[0].categories)||[]).forEach(c=>(c.positions||[]).forEach(p=>{ if(p.item) catOf[p.item.client_id]=c.name; }));
const lists = (obj.shared_option_categories||[]).map(s=>({ id:s.client_id, name:s.name, mandatory:!!s.is_mandatory, multiple:!!s.is_multiple,
options:(s.options||[]).map(o=>({name:o.name, price:(o.price||0)/100})) }));
const places = (obj.places||[]).map(p=>({id:p.client_id, name:p.name, extra:{creation_date:p.creation_date, shloud_print_all_items:!!p.shloud_print_all_items, printer_id:p.printer_id??null, should_print_unknown_items:!!p.should_print_unknown_items}}));
// Extraction sécurisée des identifiants (objets ou strings)
const placeOf = {};
(obj.places||[]).forEach(p=>(p.items||[]).forEach(it=>{
let id = null;
if (typeof it === 'string') id = it;
else if (typeof it === 'object' && it !== null) id = it.client_id || (it.item && it.item.client_id);
if(id) (placeOf[id] = placeOf[id] || []).push(p.client_id);
}));
const rows = obj.items.filter(i=>i.name).map(i=>{
const pr = i.prices||[]; const a = pr.find(p=>p.price_type===0) || pr[0]; const b = pr.find(p=>p.price_type===3);
const g = macro[i.macro_category&&i.macro_category.client_id] || 'DIVERS';
return { groupe:g, category: catOf[i.client_id]||g, name:clean(i.name),
price: a ? a.amount/100 : 0, tva: a&&a.tax ? (tax[a.tax.client_id]??20) : 20,
price2: b ? b.amount/100 : null, tva2: b ? (b.tax ? (tax[b.tax.client_id]??20) : 20) : null,
listIds:(i.shared_option_categories||[]).map(s=>s.client_id), placeIds: placeOf[i.client_id] || [] };
});
const etabFill = {};
if(obj.ticket_name) etabFill.name = obj.ticket_name; if(obj.ticket_company) etabFill.siret = obj.ticket_company.trim();
if(obj.ticket_tva) etabFill.tva = obj.ticket_tva.trim(); if(obj.ticket_naf) etabFill.naf = obj.ticket_naf.trim();
if(obj.ticket_address) etabFill.address = obj.ticket_address; if(obj.ticket_zip) etabFill.zip = obj.ticket_zip;
if(obj.ticket_city) etabFill.city = obj.ticket_city; if(obj.ticket_phone) etabFill.phone = obj.ticket_phone;
return { rows, lists, places: places.length ? places : null, etabFill };
}
/* ============ Import ============ */
function load(result, source, name){
state.rows = result.rows; state.lists = result.lists; state.source = source; state.fileName = name;
if(result.places) state.places = result.places;
else if(!state.places.length) state.places = defaultPlaces();
if(result.etabFill){
let n=0; Object.entries(result.etabFill).forEach(([k,v])=>{ const el=$('f_'+k); if(el && !el.value.trim()){ el.value=v; n++; } });
if(n){ saveEtab(); checkSiret(); log(`${n} champ(s) établissement préremplis depuis le JSON.`); }
}
$('srcInfo').textContent = `Source : ${source} — ${name}`;
$('btnClear').disabled = false;
$('editorCard').style.display = $('exportCard').style.display = 'block';
renderAll();
log(`${source} : ${state.rows.length} article(s), ${state.lists.length} liste(s).`);
toast(`${state.rows.length} articles importés`, 'ok');
}
function handleText(text, name){
try{
const t = text.trim();
if(name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json') || t.startsWith('{')) return load(parsePopinaJSON(JSON.parse(t)), 'JSON Popina', name);
if(/^(G;DESC;|A;TYPE;|D;TYPE;)/m.test(t)) return load(parseNova(text), 'Nova', name);
load(parsePopinaCSV(text), 'CSV Popina', name);
}catch(err){ console.error(err); log('Erreur : '+err.message,'e'); toast('Erreur de lecture : '+err.message,'err'); }
}
function handleFile(file){
log(`Chargement de ${file.name} (${(file.size/1024).toFixed(1)} Ko)…`);
const r = new FileReader(); r.onload = e => handleText(decode(e.target.result), file.name); r.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
}
const drop = $('drop'), fileIn = $('file');
drop.onclick = () => fileIn.click();
drop.ondragover = e => { e.preventDefault(); drop.classList.add('over'); };
drop.ondragleave = () => drop.classList.remove('over');
drop.ondrop = e => { e.preventDefault(); drop.classList.remove('over'); if(e.dataTransfer.files.length) handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]); };
fileIn.onchange = e => { if(e.target.files.length) handleFile(e.target.files[0]); fileIn.value=''; };
$('btnSample').onclick = () => handleText(
`Groupe;Famille;Description;Prix Sur place;TVA Sur place;Prix Emporter;TVA Emporter

state.rows=[]; state.lists=[]; $('editorCard').style.display=$('exportCard').style.display='none';
$('srcInfo').textContent=''; $('btnClear').disabled=true; $('log').innerHTML=''; $('log').style.display='none';
};
/* ============ Validation / rendu ============ */
function issues(){
const dup = new Map(), res = { zero:0, tva:0, dup:0, empty:0 };
state.rows.forEach(r=>{ const k=[r.groupe,r.category,r.name.toLowerCase()].join('|'); dup.set(k,(dup.get(k)||0)+1); });
state.rows.forEach(r=>{
if(!r.name) res.empty++; if(!(r.price>0)) res.zero++;
if(!tvaOk(r.tva) || (r.price2!=null && !tvaOk(r.tva2))) res.tva++;
if(dup.get([r.groupe,r.category,r.name.toLowerCase()].join('|'))>1) res.dup++;
});
return res;
}
function renderChips(){
const groups = new Set(state.rows.map(r=>r.groupe)), fams = new Set(state.rows.map(r=>r.groupe+'|'+r.category));
const i = issues();
$('chips').innerHTML =
`<div class="chip"><b>${state.rows.length}</b>articles</div>
<div class="chip"><b>${groups.size}</b>groupes</div>
<div class="chip"><b>${fams.size}</b>familles</div>
<div class="chip"><b>${state.lists.length}</b>listes</div>
<div class="chip"><b>${state.places.length}</b>pôles</div>
<div class="chip ${state.places.length && state.rows.some(r=>!(r.placeIds||[]).length)?'w':''}"><b>${state.rows.filter(r=>!(r.placeIds||[]).length).length}</b>sans pôle</div>
<div class="chip ${i.zero?'w':''}"><b>${i.zero}</b>prix à 0</div>
<div class="chip ${i.tva?'w':''}"><b>${i.tva}</b>TVA atypique</div>
<div class="chip ${i.dup?'w':''}"><b>${i.dup}</b>doublons</div>
<div class="chip ${i.empty?'e':''}"><b>${i.empty}</b>noms vides</div>`;
}
function fmt(n){ return n==null||isNaN(n) ? '' : (+n).toFixed(2); }
function renderRows(){
const q = $('q').value.trim().toLowerCase();
const dup = new Map(); state.rows.forEach(r=>{ const k=[r.groupe,r.category,r.name.toLowerCase()].join('|'); dup.set(k,(dup.get(k)||0)+1); });
const listName = id => (state.lists.find(l=>l.id===id)||{}).name || id;
let html='', shown=0;
state.rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
if(q && !(r.name+' '+r.groupe+' '+r.category).toLowerCase().includes(q)) return;
shown++;
const isDup = dup.get([r.groupe,r.category,r.name.toLowerCase()].join('|'))>1;
const w = c => c ? 'warn' : '';
html += `<tr data-i="${i}">
<td><input data-f="groupe" list="dlG" value="${esc(r.groupe)}"></td>
<td><input data-f="category" list="dlC" value="${esc(r.category)}"></td>
<td><input data-f="name" class="${!r.name?'bad':w(isDup)}" value="${esc(r.name)}"></td>
<td class="n"><input data-f="price" class="${w(!(r.price>0))}" value="${fmt(r.price)}"></td>
<td class="t"><input data-f="tva" class="${w(!tvaOk(r.tva))}" value="${esc(r.tva)}"></td>
<td class="n"><input data-f="price2" value="${fmt(r.price2)}"></td>
<td class="t"><input data-f="tva2" class="${r.price2!=null && !tvaOk(r.tva2)?'warn':''}" value="${r.tva2==null?'':esc(r.tva2)}"></td>
<td style="white-space:nowrap;font-size:.7rem">${state.places.map(p=>`<label style="margin-right:.55rem;cursor:pointer"><input type="checkbox" data-p="${esc(p.id)}" style="width:auto;vertical-align:middle" ${(r.placeIds||[]).includes(p.id)?'checked':''}> ${esc(p.name)}</label>`).join('') || '<span style="color:var(--muted)">aucun pôle</span>'}</td>
<td title="${esc(r.listIds.map(listName).join(', '))}" style="color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap">${r.listIds.length?r.listIds.length+' liste(s)':''}</td>
<td class="x"><button class="b-danger" data-del="${i}" title="Supprimer">×</button></td></tr>`;
});
$('tbody').innerHTML = html || `<tr><td colspan="10" class="empty">Aucun article à afficher.</td></tr>`;
if(!$('dlG')){ document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<datalist id="dlG"></datalist><datalist id="dlC"></datalist>'); }
$('dlG').innerHTML = [...new Set(state.rows.map(r=>r.groupe))].map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v)}">`).join('');
$('dlC').innerHTML = [...new Set(state.rows.map(r=>r.category))].map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v)}">`).join('');
}
function renderLists(){
$('lbody').innerHTML = state.lists.map((l,i)=>{
const used = state.rows.filter(r=>r.listIds.includes(l.id)).length;
return `<tr data-l="${i}">
<td><input data-lf="name" value="${esc(l.name)}"></td>
<td style="color:var(--muted)">${l.options.map(o=>esc(o.name)+(o.price?` (+${o.price.toFixed(2)}€)`:'')).join(' · ')}</td>
<td class="x"><input type="checkbox" data-lf="mandatory" ${l.mandatory?'checked':''} style="width:auto"></td>
<td class="x"><input type="checkbox" data-lf="multiple" ${l.multiple?'checked':''} style="width:auto"></td>
<td class="x">${used}</td></tr>`; }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">Aucune liste de condiments.</td></tr>`;
}
function renderPlaces(){
$('pbody').innerHTML = state.places.map((p,i)=>{
const n = state.rows.filter(r=>(r.placeIds||[]).includes(p.id)).length;
return `<tr data-pl="${i}"><td><input data-pf="name" value="${esc(p.name)}"></td><td class="x">${n}</td>
<td class="x"><button class="b-danger" data-pdel="${i}" title="Supprimer le pôle">×</button></td></tr>`;
}).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="3" class="empty">Aucun pôle. Ajoutez-en un ci-dessus.</td></tr>`;
const sel = $('bulkPlace'), prev = sel.value;
sel.innerHTML = state.places.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p.id)}">${esc(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
if(state.places.some(p=>p.id===prev)) sel.value = prev;
}
function renderAll(){ renderChips(); renderRows(); renderLists(); renderPlaces(); }
/* ============ Événements éditeur ============ */
$('tbody').addEventListener('change', e=>{
const inp = e.target;
if(inp.dataset.p){
const r = state.rows[+inp.closest('tr').dataset.i]; r.placeIds = r.placeIds || [];
if(inp.checked){ if(!r.placeIds.includes(inp.dataset.p)) r.placeIds.push(inp.dataset.p); }
else r.placeIds = r.placeIds.filter(x=>x!==inp.dataset.p);
return renderChips();
}
if(!inp.dataset.f) return;
const r = state.rows[+inp.closest('tr').dataset.i], f = inp.dataset.f; let v = inp.value.trim();
if(f==='groupe'||f==='category'||f==='name') r[f] = clean(v) || (f==='name' ? '' : (f==='groupe'?'Groupe 1':'Général'));
else if(f==='price'||f==='tva'){ const n=num(v); r[f] = isNaN(n)||n<0 ? (f==='tva'?20:0) : n; }
else if(f==='price2'||f==='tva2'){ const n=num(v); r[f] = (v===''||isNaN(n)||n<0) ? null : n; if(f==='price2' && r.price2!=null && r.tva2==null) r.tva2 = r.tva; if(f==='price2' && r.price2==null) r.tva2=null; }
renderAll();
});
$('tbody').addEventListener('click', e=>{
const b = e.target.closest('[data-del]'); if(!b) return;
state.rows.splice(+b.dataset.del,1); renderAll();
});
$('lbody').addEventListener('change', e=>{
const inp = e.target; if(!inp.dataset.lf) return; const l = state.lists[+inp.closest('tr').dataset.l];
l[inp.dataset.lf] = inp.type==='checkbox' ? inp.checked : clean(inp.value) || l.name;
});
$('q').addEventListener('input', renderRows);
$('btnAdd').onclick = () => {
const last = state.rows[state.rows.length-1] || {};
state.rows.push({groupe:last.groupe||'Groupe 1', category:last.category||'Général', name:'Nouvel article', price:0, tva:20, price2:null, tva2:null, listIds:[], placeIds:[]});
renderAll(); $('q').value=''; renderRows(); const t=$('tbody').lastElementChild; if(t) t.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});
};
$('btnBulkTva').onclick = () => {
const v = num($('bulkTva').value); if(isNaN(v)) return toast('Choisissez une TVA.','err');
const q = $('q').value.trim().toLowerCase(); let n=0;
state.rows.forEach(r=>{ if(q && !(r.name+' '+r.groupe+' '+r.category).toLowerCase().includes(q)) return; r.tva=v; if(r.price2!=null) r.tva2=v; n++; });
renderAll(); toast(`TVA ${v} % appliquée à ${n} ligne(s)`, 'ok');
};
$('btnDedupe').onclick = () => {
const seen = new Map(); const out=[]; let n=0;
state.rows.forEach(r=>{ const k=[r.groupe,r.category,r.name.toLowerCase(),r.price,r.price2].join('|'); if(seen.has(k)){ n++; return; } seen.set(k,1); out.push(r); });
state.rows = out; renderAll(); toast(n ? `${n} doublon(s) exact(s) supprimé(s)` : 'Aucun doublon exact', n?'ok':'');
};
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t=>t.onclick=()=>{
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===t));
document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('on',p.id===t.dataset.pane));
});
/* ============ Pôles de préparation ============ */
const filteredRows = () => { const q = $('q').value.trim().toLowerCase();
return state.rows.filter(r => !q || (r.name+' '+r.groupe+' '+r.category).toLowerCase().includes(q)); };
function addPlace(name){
name = clean(name); if(!name) return false;
if(state.places.some(p=>p.name.toLowerCase()===name.toLowerCase())){ toast(`Le pôle « ${name} » existe déjà.`,'err'); return false; }
state.places.push({id:uuid(), name, extra:{}}); return true;
}
$('btnAddPlace').onclick = () => { if(addPlace($('newPlace').value)){ $('newPlace').value=''; renderAll(); } };
$('newPlace').addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') $('btnAddPlace').click(); });
$('btnQuickPlaces').onclick = () => { const a=addPlace('Chaud'), b=addPlace('Froid'); if(a||b) renderAll(); };
$('pbody').addEventListener('change', e=>{
const inp = e.target; if(inp.dataset.pf!=='name') return;
const p = state.places[+inp.closest('tr').dataset.pl]; p.name = clean(inp.value) || p.name; renderAll();
});
$('pbody').addEventListener('click', e=>{
const b = e.target.closest('[data-pdel]'); if(!b) return;
const p = state.places[+b.dataset.pdel];
if(!confirm(`Supprimer le pôle « ${p.name} » ?`)) return;
state.rows.forEach(r=>{ r.placeIds = (r.placeIds||[]).filter(x=>x!==p.id); });
state.places.splice(+b.dataset.pdel,1); renderAll();
});
function bulkPlace(mode){
const id = $('bulkPlace').value; if(!id) return toast("Créez d'abord un pôle.",'err');
const rows = filteredRows(); if(!rows.length) return toast('Aucune ligne affichée.','err');
rows.forEach(r=>{
r.placeIds = r.placeIds || [];
if(mode==='add'){ if(!r.placeIds.includes(id)) r.placeIds.push(id); }
else if(mode==='remove'){ r.placeIds = r.placeIds.filter(x=>x!==id); }
else r.placeIds = [id];
});
renderAll();
const nm = (state.places.find(p=>p.id===id)||{}).name;
toast(`${({add:'Affecté à',remove:'Retiré de',set:'Remplacé par'})[mode]} « ${nm} » : ${rows.length} ligne(s)`, 'ok');
}
$('btnPlaceAdd').onclick = () => bulkPlace('add');
$('btnPlaceRemove').onclick = () => bulkPlace('remove');
$('btnPlaceSet').onclick = () => bulkPlace('set');
/* ============ Exports ============ */
function buildJSON(){
const e = etab(), now = new Date().toISOString();
const macroMap = new Map(), catMap = new Map(), famCount = new Map();
const listMap = new Map();
const shared = [];
const usedLists = new Set(state.rows.flatMap(r=>r.listIds));
state.lists.filter(l=>l.options.length && usedLists.has(l.id)).forEach((l,i)=>{
const id = uuid(); listMap.set(l.id,id);
shared.push({ client_id:id, index:i, name:l.name, is_mandatory:l.mandatory, is_multiple:l.multiple,
options:l.options.map((o,j)=>({client_id:uuid(), index:j, name:o.name, price:Math.round((o.price||0)*100)})) });
});
const items = []; const placeItems = {};
state.rows.forEach(r=>{
if(!r.name) return;
if(!macroMap.has(r.groupe)) macroMap.set(r.groupe,{id:uuid(), index:macroMap.size});
const m = macroMap.get(r.groupe); if(!famCount.has(m.id)) famCount.set(m.id,0);
const ck = r.groupe+'__'+r.category;
if(!catMap.has(ck)){ const idx=famCount.get(m.id); famCount.set(m.id,idx+1); catMap.set(ck,{id:uuid(), name:r.category, macroId:m.id, index:idx, positions:[]}); }
const c = catMap.get(ck), itemId = uuid();
const prices = [{client_id:uuid(), name:null, amount:Math.round(r.price*100), price_type:0, tax:{client_id:taxId(r.tva)}}];
if(r.price2!=null) prices.push({client_id:uuid(), name:null, amount:Math.round(r.price2*100), price_type:3, tax:{client_id:taxId(r.tva2!=null?r.tva2:r.tva)}});
items.push({ name:r.name, client_id:itemId, modular_price:false, preparation_step_index:-1, screen_name:null, kitchen_name:null, sku:null,
date_creation:now, barcode:null, is_weight_price:false, kilo_price:0.0, item_is_limodade:false, option_categories:[], prices,
macro_category:{client_id:m.id}, shared_option_categories: r.listIds.filter(id=>listMap.has(id)).map(id=>({client_id:listMap.get(id)})) });
c.positions.push({client_id:uuid(), highlight_level:0, brightness_level:0, alternate_color:-1, index:c.positions.length, item:{client_id:itemId}});
(r.placeIds||[]).forEach(pid=>{ (placeItems[pid] = placeItems[pid] || []).push(itemId); });
});
// Construction des places avec des UUIDs sous forme de chaînes simples
const placesOut = state.places.map(p=>({
client_id:p.id,
creation_date:(p.extra&&p.extra.creation_date)||now,
name:p.name,
shloud_print_all_items:!!(p.extra&&p.extra.shloud_print_all_items),
printer_id:(p.extra&&p.extra.printer_id)||null,
should_print_unknown_items:!!(p.extra&&p.extra.should_print_unknown_items),
items: placeItems[p.id] || []
}));
const out = baseData(e, now, placesOut);
out.macro_categories = [...macroMap].map(([name,v])=>({client_id:v.id, name, index:v.index, color:0, image:'Fichier 9', preparation_step_index:-1, number_of_categories:8}));
out.shared_option_categories = shared;
out.items = items;
out.cards = [{ client_id:uuid(), name:'Carte Principale', selections:[], menus:[],
categories:[...catMap.values()].map(c=>({client_id:c.id, name:c.name, index:c.index, number_of_columns:2, number_of_lines:8, positions:c.positions, macro_category:{client_id:c.macroId}})) }];
return { json: JSON.stringify(out,null,2), items: items.length, groups: macroMap.size, lists: shared.length };
}
const q2 = s => '"'+String(s).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
function buildCSV(){
const L = ['Groupe (Macro-catégorie);Famille;Description (Nom article);Prix Sur place;TVA Sur place;Prix Emporter;TVA Emporter'];
state.rows.forEach(r=>L.push([q2(r.groupe),q2(r.category),q2(r.name),fmt(r.price),r.tva,fmt(r.price2),r.price2!=null?(r.tva2??r.tva):''].join(';')));
return L.join('\r\n')+'\r\n';
}
function buildTDE(){
const s = v => String(v).replace(/;/g,' ').trim();
const L = ['#PLU;GROUP;DEPT;DESCRIPTION;LONG_DESCRIPTION;KP_PLU_NOTES;PRICE_1;PRICE_2;PRICE_3;PRICE_4;PRICE_5;PRICE_6;BARCODE;PREFERED;ON_TDE'];
state.rows.forEach(r=>L.push(['',s(r.groupe),s(r.category),s(r.name),'','',Math.round(r.price*100),r.price2!=null?Math.round(r.price2*100):'','','','','','','',''].join(';')));
return L.join('\r\n')+'\r\n';
}
function preflight(){
if(!state.rows.length){ toast('Rien à exporter.','err'); return false; }
const i = issues();
if(i.empty){ toast(`${i.empty} article(s) sans nom : corrigez ou supprimez-les.`,'err'); return false; }
const nop = state.rows.filter(r=>!(r.placeIds||[]).length).length;
if(state.places.length && nop) log(`${nop} article(s) sans pôle de préparation (non envoyés en cuisine/bar).`,'w');
if(i.tva) log(`${i.tva} article(s) avec une TVA hors 5,5/10/20 : ils seront exportés en TVA 20 % côté JSON.`,'w');
return true;
}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-exp]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
if(!preflight()) return;
const base = slug(etab().name) || slug(state.fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'')) || 'carte';
const kind = b.dataset.exp;
if(kind==='json'){ const r = buildJSON(); download(r.json, base+'_popina.json','application/json'); toast(`JSON : ${r.items} articles, ${r.groups} groupes, ${r.lists} listes`,'ok'); log(`Export JSON : ${r.items} articles, ${r.lists} listes.`); }
if(kind==='csv'){ download(buildCSV(), base+'_popina.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8',true); toast('CSV Popina exporté','ok'); }
if(kind==='tde'){ download(buildTDE(), base+'_smartTDE.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8'); toast('CSV SmartTDE exporté','ok'); }
});
/* ============ Init ============ */
loadEtab();
</script>
</body>
</html>
